item.title: Whatever you do, don’t buy a Galaxy S25 right now
item.description: It’s rare that we’d urge people not to buy phones that we warmly recommended just a few months ago, but that’s the case right now. Samsung’s Galaxy S25, Galaxy S25+ and Galaxy S25 Ultra were undoubtedly some of the best phones of 2025. Indeed, the Ultra remains the third finest handset you can buy at the time of writing. item.title: The Pixel Tablet just got a new lease of life, but it could be bad news too
item.description: If you own a Google Pixel Tablet, then there’s good news. The firm just quietly extended its lifespan with a longer software update promise. The Android slate cum smart display remains Google’s only tablet and it was due to get its last major OS software update in 2026. However, Google has updated its policy from three years to five. item.title: The White Lotus season 4 unveils its star-studded cast
item.description: After months of rumours, HBO has revealed not only where the fourth season of The White Lotus will be filmed, but also who will portray the over-privileged hotel guests. In case you needed reminding, The White Lotus is a dark satire about money, more money, sex, families and the decadent side of five-star tourism. Those themes likely won’t change.
